blocks.text: Anthropic, PBC 今日公布其首次公开募股（IPO）的 A 类普通股定价为每股 83.00 美元。本次发行共包含 980,000,000 股 A 类普通股，其中 956,351,354 股由 Anthropic 出售，23,648,646 股由若干售股股东出售。Anthropic 不会从售股股东出售的股份中获得任何收益。

blocks.text: 这些股份预计将于 2026 年 11 月 19 日在纳斯达克全球精选市场开始交易，股票代码为“ANT”。本次发行预计将于 2026 年 11 月 20 日完成交割，但须满足惯例交割条件。此外，Anthropic 已授予承销商一项 30 天期权，可额外购买最多 147,000,000 股 A 类普通股。

blocks.text: Today Anthropic, PBC priced its initial public offering of its Class A common stock at $83.00 per share. The offering consists of 980,000,000 shares of Class A common stock, 956,351,354 of which are being sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 of which are being sold by certain selling stockholders. Anthropic will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling stockholders.

blocks.text: The shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on November 19, 2026 under the symbol “ANT.” The offering is expected to close on November 20, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions. In addition, Anthropic has granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 147,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock.
